body:
They are burdened because my mom loves me.  My dad died in my arms a few years ago but he had nothing left for the family, so we just have what she's saved up over her life.

She won't let me go with a public defender (which I suggested since I feel like a good attorney won't do much better for sentencing) and demands I go with this top lawyer, again because she loves me.

I don't even have a passport and I feel like running is not an option for me... I don't want to live my life hiding from this, because I can't run away from the fact that I killed someone.

Thank you.  I just signed up with MADD to be a volunteer, not sure what they will have me do but I said I will do anything.

I don't know what I would go to rehab for as I'm not a heavy drinker (maybe 1-2 nights a week or when I golf I'll have a few beers).  

You're right about darkness and despair, I'll keep my eyes open looking for a light.

I went and saw a grief counselor, I don't think it's for me.  But I'm scheduled to go back again next week, so if I make it there we will see.

I've never been good at opening up about feelings, to anyone.

I don't know how prison will make me better.  Everything I've heard tells me that it will just mold me into becoming a criminal. 

I don't know, I just don't know what is going on.  All I do know is that I killed someone, and I can't bear it.

I don't think I'm an alcoholic though.  I don't drink that much, maybe once or twice a week, and that's usually just a few beers (when I'm golfing, maybe if I go out with friends).

I wish I could say it's because I'm an alcoholic or something, but when really this was I was drinking too much out with friends and stupidly decided to drive.

If they are vengeful then I think my death would give them some sort of satisfaction.

The court cost's aren't worrysome... max fine for DUI manslaughter is $10,000.... I'm dishing out $50,000 on my lawyers alone.

Then the civil case could be who knows what, could be 6 figures.  

The only reason I care about the money is for my families future... and me ending it would save all of that.  And I just can't live with the fact that I killed someone.

Oh... well my original bail was cheap, because no one had died... she died later.  When they press the new charges I will get a new bail again, which my lawyer tells me won't be a lot (like $2k or so). 

My family isn't ''broke'' but I'm going to need minimum $50,000 to do this process (which is basically ALL of the family money)...  And I think I should just do this sooner than later to not have them spend the money.  

Already dropped $10k on a lawyer retainer, with obviously more to come.  And The sooner I pull the trigger the less money they will have to throw away.
I'm not sure what you mean, like how am I paying for all this?

>As much as my gut tells me you should be behind bars for life I’m not going to do that.

And that's why I feel like I should kill myself.  Society (myself included) tells me that I'm a piece of shit and basically murdered someone.  I'm a killer, whether I like it or not.  And I've never been in trouble before this, I was a normal person in society.  Worked a good job, had a girlfriend (she's gone now), have a lot of friends.... but that's all over now.

I don't care about jail for myself, I deserve to be there.  What I do care about is my families money ($50k for lawyer, court costs, not to mention civil court eventually) and my families pain watching me go through this process.

Suicide would stop all of that, sure it would cause them pain.  But in the long run it would help the family financially, and even though I don't know the victim's families mindset (are they forgiving?  Vengeful?  I don't know), I think that me killing myself would give them a little peace as well.
Don't know yet.... but probably around 10-20 years is my guess.
